🟧🟥TCHILAR KIZOMBA FESTIVAL VII 🟧🟥🎉
https://my.weezevent.com/tchilar-kizomba-festival-vii?
TCHILAR, more than a dance festival: a celebration of Angolan culture through Kizomba, Semba, Kuduro, gastronomy, and educational workshops.
TCHILAR is more than a dance festival — it is the joy of Kizomba and Semba e Motion with
International and local artists ,
Joins us to try it
Experience a unique weekend full of:
✨ Energy
✨ Fun
✨ Gastronomy
✨ Animations
✨ Social Dancing
✨ Amazing Night Parties
Located in the beautiful Three Lakes Region of Switzerland, TCHILAR brings together dancers and music lovers from all over Europe.
After the huge success of TCHILAR Kizomba Festival VI, we are proud to announce that:
🚀 THE 7TH EDITION IS COMING!
This year, we are coming bigger and stronger than ever! Because you definitely deserve it for your support during this 7 long years of our working to bring it together for you all!
